residual.detail: save_todos() truncates todo.json before writing (open(path,'w') then json.dump); a crash or kill mid-write leaves the file corrupt/truncated, losing prior todos. Not a spec violation (spec only guarantees valid JSON on success) but a real durability hazard. Fix: write to a temp file and os.replace() onto todo.json.

save_todos() has no try/except around the write, unlike load_todos(); an OSError on write (permission denied, disk full) would produce a raw traceback on stderr instead of the one-line error-message convention used elsewhere in the CLI. Exit code still happens to be 1.
